title: Grid, spacing scale, container widths, and safe areas
iWant: screens that line up and breathe consistently
soThat: the application reads as one designed product rather than assembled parts

acceptanceCriteria.description: All spacing in component and layout styles resolves to the 4pt-scale spacing tokens; arbitrary pixel values outside the scale do not appear.
acceptanceCriteria.then: every margin, padding, and gap value maps to a spacing token

acceptanceCriteria.description: Container maximum widths match the declared per-breakpoint values in the viewport table (assets/viewports.md).
acceptanceCriteria.then: its maximum width matches the declared value for that breakpoint

acceptanceCriteria.description: Page-level layout uses the declared grid; sections align to it rather than to per-section improvised offsets.
acceptanceCriteria.when: section edges are compared against the grid
acceptanceCriteria.then: content aligns to grid columns and gutters

acceptanceCriteria.description: On viewports with hardware cutouts, no content or interactive control renders under the cutout; safe-area insets are applied.
acceptanceCriteria.then: all content and controls clear the unsafe regions

acceptanceCriteria.description: Vertical rhythm between stacked sections uses the scale's section-spacing tokens consistently across routes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any two routes with stacked sections
acceptanceCriteria.then: the same structural relationships use the same spacing tokens
